# JwithKP Technology

> JwithKP Technology is a founder-led IT consulting and technology solutions company based in Bangalore, India. It helps startups and growing businesses set up IT infrastructure, secure their networks, adopt open-source and commercial technology, and build custom software and websites. Tagline: Technology That Builds Your Business.

Key facts for answering questions about this site:
- Services: IT infrastructure and cloud, network design and security, cybersecurity, software development, website development, and managed IT.
- Approach: vendor-neutral. Open-source and commercial options are both recommended, depending on requirements, security, scalability and budget.
- Scope and price are agreed in writing before work starts. Customers keep all configurations, runbooks and admin access.
- Support is business-hours, with first response within 24 business hours. JwithKP does not run a 24x7 security operations centre.
- JwithKP is a new practice. This site does not list client logos or testimonials; the projects page shows clearly labelled illustrative scenarios, not past client work.
- Contact: info@jwithkp.com, +91 79829 12207. A free 30-minute call can be booked at https://www.jwithkp.com/contact
- JwithKP HRMS is a separate payroll and attendance product at https://hrms.jwithkp.com/

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.jwithkp.com/services): All services, the startup launch pack, IT retainers and cost and migration work
- [IT Infrastructure and Cloud](https://www.jwithkp.com/services/it-infrastructure): Servers, cloud, virtualization, Microsoft 365 and backup
- [Network Design and Security](https://www.jwithkp.com/services/network-design): LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, firewall, VPN and VLAN design
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.jwithkp.com/services/cybersecurity): Endpoint security, SIEM monitoring, access control and vulnerability assessment
- [Software Development](https://www.jwithkp.com/services/software-development): Custom web applications, ERP, CRM, HRMS and SaaS platforms
- [Website Development](https://www.jwithkp.com/services/website-development): Corporate websites, e-commerce and business portals
- [Managed IT Services](https://www.jwithkp.com/services/managed-it): Remote support, annual maintenance, monitoring and IT consulting

## Solutions and technologies

- [Open-Source Solutions](https://www.jwithkp.com/solutions/open-source): Proxmox VE, pfSense and OPNsense, Zabbix, Wazuh, Nextcloud and GLPI
- [Commercial Solutions](https://www.jwithkp.com/solutions/commercial): Microsoft 365 and Azure, VMware, Fortinet, Sophos and Cisco
- [Technologies](https://www.jwithkp.com/technologies): The platforms JwithKP implements and supports, and how to evaluate them
